title: Grounded AI answers — Ask from your docs, not just posts
notes: Ask can now answer from your built-in documentation and changelog (the authoritative source of how the software works) and cite the exact guide, instead of paraphrasing forum posts. A new Strict support mode answers only from your knowledge base and says when something isn't documented rather than guessing — ideal for a support site.

changelog.text: Ask answers from your documentation + changelog, with citations — not just forum posts.
Strict support mode: answer only from the knowledge base; say when something isn't documented.
